title: Backtest to the Future: Can Large Language Models Generate Publishable AI Research Ideas?

contributions.purpose: 首个标准化 backtesting 协议评估 LLM 科研构思能力
contributions.mechanism: 7 个 LLM 生成 700 个想法,用 text-embedding-3-small 语义匹配 11,672 篇 ICLR2025 摘要
contributions.evaluation: 89.7% 想法高相似(mean 0.826, σ=0.113);可复现基准
contributions.domain: LLM 科研构思 / 自动科学发现
contributions.source_quote: the first standardized backtesting protocol for evaluating LLM research ideation capabilities, establishing a reproducible benchmark for the field

contributions.purpose: 揭示相似度与人类质量评分的负相关
contributions.mechanism: 将匹配想法与人类论文质量评分做相关分析
contributions.evaluation: 负相关 r=-0.097, p=0.015(|r|<0.1);最相似想法反而质量评分更低
contributions.source_quote: the most similar ideas receive lower human quality assessments, yielding a modest negative correlation (|r| < 0.1)

contributions.purpose: 比较 7 个当代 LLM 的构思能力
contributions.mechanism: 跨模型/跨领域相似度与质量分层分析
contributions.evaluation: 显著性能分层;定位 LLM 为既有轨迹的系统探索者
contributions.source_quote: comprehensive comparison of seven contemporary LLMs revealing significant performance stratification

self_declared_provenance.quote: Backtesting, a methodology borrowed from quantitative finance where trading strategies are validated against historical market data, provides a rigorous framework for retrospective validation.

notes: 负结果=利用-探索分裂:AI 想法与人类研究越相似,人类质量评分越低(负相关 r=-0.097, p=0.015),LLM 擅长增量而非突破。有编号贡献列表。raw data 提供 anonymous.4open.science 链接。checklist 基本 Yes。无造数红旗。
